summary: Use a row of four integers to see what content means. Then trade coefficients for samples to explain why only one factor of two can survive.
summary_zh: 先用四个系数认识多项式的内容，再把系数换成取样值，看公因数为何至多保留一个因数二。
title: Why only one or two?
title_zh: 系数的公因数为何只有一或二？
